name: absgs-3k
question: Does AbsGS densification (absolute 2-D gradients) improve novel-view quality, in particular on glass, contours and furniture, relative to the default criterion?
modification: only the densification criterion: strategy.absgrad = true and grow_grad2d = 0.0008 (one method; gsplat states the threshold must be raised with absgrad); everything else identical
reference: AbsGS: Recovering Fine Details for 3D Gaussian Splatting (arXiv 2404.10484)
design: paired: for each seed 0, 1, 2 a baseline and an AbsGS arm, 3000 steps, same schedule (densification i = 600..2400, no large-Gaussian pruning, position LR decay over 3000 steps, SH degree <= 2)

metrics.primary: paired difference AbsGS - baseline of mean validation PSNR and SSIM at 3000, overall and per validation panorama
secondary: region PSNR (glass, contours, furniture, mirror, unvalidated reflective)
Gaussian count, large and out-of-box (opaque) Gaussians

reading: mean, median, standard deviation and signs over all seeds, without selecting favourable seeds; the standard deviation is the observed variability, not an isolated GPU non-determinism; the 0.244 dB replicate gap is a historical reference from another partition, not a statistical threshold; no winner on mean PSNR alone
not_used: test set R0010008, R0010014 (reserved; evaluate-test --final not run)
seed_status: seeds 0-2 run; seeds 3-5 to run with unchanged parameters; the six pairs are analysed together, none excluded, at step 3000 and at the selected checkpoints, per validation panorama

diagnostics.name: near-gaussian ablation, seed 2 baseline
diagnostics.scope: absgs-base-seed2 only, validation panorama R0010011, checkpoint step_003000 (vs step_002000)
diagnostics.finding: removing, in memory and per face, Gaussians whose oriented 3-sigma depth extent comes near the camera changes the validation metrics of these faces: an effect of removal is shown
diagnostics.not_shown: why these Gaussians grew; any generalisation to other seeds, panoramas or checkpoints
diagnostics.caveat: each ablation removes a different set per face: it is not a single cleaned model
diagnostics.consequence: seed 2 and all checkpoints stay in the comparison; no code or data defect is established; a separate correction experiment defines one rule from training views
